explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/1081 with Odoni's negative answer. A(x) counts 1 ≤ n ≤ x expressible as a + b with a, b ≥ 1 squarefull (Nat.Powerful = 2-full, with 1 counted as squarefull). The statement negates the existence of c > 0 with A(x) ~ c·x/√(log x). Excluding a = 0 or b = 0 only removes O(√x) numbers, which is negligible.
